title: On Participating in the search from the first hour
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：participate　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 participate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the keeper ① participated in the search from the first hour in the rain, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② participates in the search from the first hour without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ participate in the search from the first hour at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ participated in the search from the first hour before — a line in the calendar for January 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Participating in the search from the first hour in the rain, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ participate in every decision thereafter without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Participate in every decision thereafter at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ participates in every decision thereafter in the rain every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ participated in the search from the first hour again when nobody else would.

⑩ To participate in the search from the first hour, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody participates in the search from the first hour without complaint again and somebody must participate in the search from the first hour in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 参加（一般过去式 participated in the search from the first hour：1962 年守夜人头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 参加（一般现在 participates in the search from the first hour：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 参加（不定式 to participate in the search from the first hour：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 参加（过去完成时 had participated in the search from the first hour：1956 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 参加（动名词 participating in the search from the first hour 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 参与（participate in every decision thereafter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去参与此后参与了每一个决定）
G. v. 参与（participate in every decision thereafter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 参加（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 participates in every decision thereafter，而母亲又一次 participated in the search from the first hour）

participate 意为“参加”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例参与此后参与了每一个决定，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 participates。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 participate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the keeper participated in the search from the first hour in the rain, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper participates in the search from the first hour without complaint whenever the tower asks.
Participating in the search from the first hour in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever participate in every decision thereafter without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower participates in every decision thereafter in the rain every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother participated in the search from the first hour again, and the tower remembered that half.
